          Tournament Popup Image

          PNG · 1000 × 750 px · transparent

          Upload the four side elements, then drag them into place on the preview. Use the round handles to resize and rotate, or the sliders on the left. The trophy and the light ring are fixed.

          Elements

          Layer order, top to bottom: trophy · 1 & 2 front · 3 & 4 back · light ring. PNG, WebP or SVG with a transparent background; empty edges are trimmed.

          Editing

          • Click an element on the preview to select it, drag to move.
          • White handle (corner): resize. Orange handle (top): rotate – hold Shift to step by 15°.
          • Arrow keys nudge 1 px (Shift: 10 px); + / − resize; [ / ] rotate 1°.
          • Hold Alt while dragging to turn off snapping to the centre line.

            Logo Resize

            PNG · 124 × 82 px · light + dark

            Drop a logo you found online. The tool removes a plain background, fits the logo edge to edge into 124 × 82 px and builds the missing light- or dark-mode version. Upload both versions if you have them.

            Light-mode logo

            For light backgrounds – usually the dark-coloured version. Optional – leave one empty and it is generated from the other.

            This looks like the other version.
            Tolerance12

            Turn on “Inside shapes too” if the background still shows inside letters like O or A.

            Dark-mode logo

            For dark backgrounds – usually the white or light version. Optional – leave one empty and it is generated from the other.

            This looks like the other version.
